title: A table for two orders
lesson: Three matching pieces make one batch. Future orders keep their prepared food.

tutorial_guide.title: Prepare one corn batch
tutorial_guide.body: Orders ask for batches. Match these three corn pieces to prepare one corn batch for the first plate.

tutorial_guide.title: Prepare something for later
tutorial_guide.body: Corn is ready! The first plate still needs mushrooms. Match the peppers now; the next plate will keep that batch as Prepared.

tutorial_guide.title: Prepared food waits for you
tutorial_guide.body: The next plate has its pepper batch safely Prepared. Match the mushrooms to serve the first plate, then the next one can follow.

tutorial_complete: Both plates are served and every tray is clear! Each triple made one batch, and the next order kept its Prepared pepper batch.
